cards.title: Claude Gains Shared Memory Across Chat
cards.body: Anthropic is giving Claude a shared memory feature across chat and Cowork, eliminating repetitive briefings on projects and preferences. Users no longer need to re-explain context in every conversation.

cards.title: Gamma Acquires Design Startup Lica
cards.body: Gamma has acquired Accel-backed design startup Lica, with co-founders joining Gamma's new research team. The move strengthens Gamma's design and AI capabilities.

cards.title: OpenAI Debuts Jalapeño Inference Chip
cards.body: OpenAI's Jalapeño chip outperforms state-of-the-art alternatives in SemiAnalysis benchmarks for both tokens per user and throughput per kilowatt. The chip is designed for fast, scalable AI inference.

cards.title: Keenable Exits Stealth with $26M Seed
cards.body: Accel-backed Keenable is launching with $26 million in seed funding to build a web search index specifically for AI agents. The startup is indexing the internet for autonomous AI systems.

cards.title: OpenAI's Head of Product on AI Agents
cards.body: TechCrunch interviews Thibault Sottiaux, OpenAI's head of product, about the company's agent strategy, UX priorities, and future direction. He reports directly to Greg Brockman.

cards.title: AI Hedge Fund Situational Awareness Under SEC Probe
cards.body: Situational Awareness, once a Wall Street sensation, is now facing federal subpoenas from the SEC. The AI hedge fund's rapid decline from prominence marks a dramatic turnaround.

cards.title: Trump Purchases SpaceX Shares Post-IPO
cards.body: President Trump bought SpaceX shares at mid-$150 range two weeks after the IPO, which priced at $135. The stock has since returned to its original IPO price.

cards.title: Replit CEO Joins TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
cards.body: Amjad Masad, CEO and co-founder of Replit, will speak at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 about the future of programming. He'll discuss Replit's role in shaping AI-assisted development.

cards.title: Instinct AI Assistant Raises Privacy Concerns
cards.body: Early testers praise Instinct's capabilities but flag serious privacy and security trade-offs from its sweeping access and broad permissions. The AI assistant's ability to act autonomously raises uncomfortable questions.

cards.title: General Intuition Targets $6B Valuation
cards.body: General Intuition, building a foundation model for generalized AI agents in robotics, is in talks for $6B pre-money funding from Valor Ventures and Point72 Ventures. The startup focuses on training AI systems for spatial and temporal reasoning.

cards.title: OpenAI Pushes AI Agents to Mainstream
cards.body: OpenAI is expanding AI agents from software engineers to general users across multiple domains. The frontier lab is democratizing agent technology for everyday tasks.

cards.title: Hugging Face Reportedly Valued at $13B
cards.body: Hugging Face has reportedly fielded acquisition offers valuing the company around $13B. Founders' commitment to the community may affect sale prospects.

cards.title: Mystery AI Model Ox Alpha Sparks Speculation
cards.body: A mysterious stealth AI model called Ox Alpha has ignited internet speculation about its creators and capabilities. The unnamed model's origins remain shrouded in mystery.

cards.title: Linkdaze Smart Calendar Includes AI Meal Planner
cards.body: Linkdaze's digital calendar offers AI-powered meal planning and household management without paywalls. The smart calendar stands out for bundling features typically behind subscription walls.

cards.title: Flock Safety CEO Addresses Surveillance Backlash
cards.body: Flock Safety's CEO calls for 'compromise' as the surveillance company faces growing public outcry. Concerns center on potential misuse of its surveillance technology.

cards.title: Copyright Training of AI Models Legally Unclear
cards.body: Most published authors have unknowingly contributed their work to AI model training without consent or compensation. The legality of this practice remains complicated and contested.

cards.title: Harvard Bootcamp Features AI Instructor Avatars
cards.body: Harvard's $699 HBS Foundry bootcamp deploys AI avatars of instructors to provide feedback on practice pitches and board meetings. The program blends human instruction with AI coaching.

cards.title: DeepMind Alumni's Faraday Outperforms Top Labs
cards.body: Inherent's Faraday AI agent, built by DeepMind alumni, outperformed Anthropic and OpenAI models in replicating scientific research. The agent demonstrates potential for accelerating scientific innovation.

cards.title: OpenAI Supports Stronger California AI Safety Bill
cards.body: OpenAI's global affairs team advocates for strengthening California's AI safety legislation to address emerging risks. The company referenced recent incidents as evidence for updated protections.

cards.title: AI Labs Lack Rogue Model Containment Plans
cards.body: A new study finds leading AI labs have minimal publicly documented plans for containing rogue models despite increasing unexpected AI behavior. The gap raises serious preparedness concerns as systems grow more capable.

cards.title: Claude Remembers Context Across Chats
cards.body: Anthropic is giving Claude shared memory so users don't have to repeatedly brief the AI on projects and preferences. This persistent context carries across both chat and Cowork applications.

cards.title: OpenAI's Jalapeño Chip Beats Benchmarks
cards.body: OpenAI's custom inference chip outperformed state-of-the-art competitors on SemiAnalysis' InferenceX benchmark. It delivered more tokens per user and higher throughput per kilowatt than existing solutions.

cards.title: Keenable Exits Stealth with $26M Seed
cards.body: Keenable is indexing the web specifically for AI agents with a $26 million seed round. The startup addresses a critical need for AI systems to access current web information.

cards.title: OpenAI Head of Product on AI Agents
cards.body: OpenAI's Thibault Sottiaux discusses the company's push into agents, UX design, and strategic direction. The interview covers how OpenAI plans to bring AI agents to mainstream users.

cards.title: Instinct's AI Assistant Raises Privacy Concerns
cards.body: Early testers praise Instinct's AI capabilities but worry about its broad access permissions and ability to act autonomously. The trade-offs between functionality and security are raising questions.

cards.title: General Intuition Raises at $6B Valuation
cards.body: The startup building foundation models for generalized AI agents is in talks to raise at a $6 billion pre-money valuation. Investors include Valor Ventures, Point72, and Seven Seven Six.

cards.title: OpenAI Pushes AI Agents Beyond Engineers
cards.body: OpenAI is expanding AI agents from software engineers to mainstream users through frontier lab development. The push aims to democratize agent technology across industries.

cards.title: Hugging Face in $13B Acquisition Talks
cards.body: The AI community platform has been fielding acquisition offers valuing it around $13 billion. Founder concerns about community responsibility may impact whether a sale proceeds.

cards.title: Mystery AI Model Ox Alpha Sparks Speculation
cards.body: A mysterious new stealth AI model called Ox Alpha has generated intense speculation across tech communities. Details about its creators and capabilities remain shrouded in secrecy.

cards.title: Legal Questions Surround AI Training on Books
cards.body: Authors' copyrighted works have been used to train AI models without knowledge or consent, raising legal concerns. The article examines whether this practice violates copyright protections.

cards.title: Harvard Bootcamp Uses AI Instructor Avatars
cards.body: HBS Foundry's $699 startup bootcamp employs AI avatars of instructors to provide feedback on pitches. The avatars participate in mock board meetings and practice scenarios.

cards.title: DeepMind Alumni Launch Research-Replicating AI
cards.body: Inherent's Faraday AI agent outperformed Anthropic and OpenAI at replicating scientific papers, according to the lab. The capability could accelerate scientific innovation and discovery.

cards.title: OpenAI Backs California AI Safety Legislation
cards.body: OpenAI's global affairs team supports strengthening California's AI safety bill. The company referenced recent incidents that underscore the need for updated protections.

cards.title: AI Labs Lack Rogue Model Containment Plans
cards.body: A new study finds leading AI labs have few documented plans for containing rogue models. The gap raises preparedness concerns as AI systems show unexpected behaviors.

cards.title: Sotheby's Uses AI Algorithms for Art Pricing
cards.body: Sotheby's employs AI algorithms to predict fine art prices using buying trends and artist popularity. The application represents growing adoption of AI in the art market.

cards.title: Humanoid Robots Transform Chinese Daily Life
cards.body: China's robot carnival showcases embodied AI, embedding artificial intelligence into physical systems. The deployment reflects China's strategy to integrate AI into everyday life.

cards.title: Schools Seek Smarter Classroom AI Use
cards.body: Educational institutions are developing strategies to encourage responsible AI chatbot use among students. The challenge lies in harnessing AI benefits while maintaining learning integrity.

cards.title: Children Outlearn AI Language Models
cards.body: Human children remain superior to AI language models at learning language fluency despite LLMs requiring massive datasets. The cognitive difference highlights fundamental gaps in how AI and humans learn.

cards.title: Insilico Medicine Uses AI to Design Drugs
cards.body: The biotech company used generative AI to propose a promising drug for pulmonary fibrosis. The success raises questions about credit attribution when AI contributes to discovery.

cards.title: AI Transforms Radiologist Jobs, Not Replacement
cards.body: AI won't replace radiologists but will dramatically change how they work and prioritize cases. The technology augments rather than eliminates the human expertise required.

cards.title: Apple Designs Macs for Local AI Development
cards.body: Apple's new desktop computers are specifically engineered for on-device AI model development. The focus on local processing reflects growing interest in privacy-preserving AI.

cards.title: AI Hits Entry-Level Jobs Hardest
cards.body: A Stanford study finds AI automation disproportionately impacts entry-level employment across industries. The research highlights challenges for workers starting their careers.

cards.title: Nvidia Executive Tied to AI Smuggling Scheme
cards.body: A senior Nvidia manager has connections to an ex-Supermicro employee involved in AI chip smuggling. The case raises concerns about supply chain security for critical AI hardware.
